label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017
output:
Rick,

I need to say this straight so I don’t sit on it until Thanksgiving.

You told Gary Pruitt I’d list his 4-bed in Chandler off Ray Rd for 1%. My listing side is 2.5%. I have never said 1% to anybody, and you didn’t ask me before you threw that number around. I spent Saturday, Nov. 7 pulling comps, doing the walkthrough, and printing a full listing packet — about six hours plus the drive from north Phoenix. Then Gary texts Sunday night that he’s going with ListLite, $3,995 flat fee, “no hard feelings.”

When I called you, you said, “That’s business, sis, can’t win ’em all.” That’s not business. That’s you promising my time and my commission to your friend without asking me.

And this morning you text that Denise wants to pick my brain about selling her rental and you already gave her my cell. Same as your softball guy two years ago. I let that one go. I’m not letting this go. You get to look like the big shot with your friends and I do the work for free.

I’m not mad at Gary, honestly — he made a business call. I’m mad at you. This isn’t about one deal. It’s about you treating my business like a favor you can hand out.

I’m happy to help actual family — Mom, your kids, anybody — with advice, no charge. But no more handing out my number. No more quoting my commission. Ask me first, every time.

I’m not calling Denise. You can tell her.

I’m mad, but I’m not going nuclear. You’re my brother, and we’re still doing Thanksgiving at your place. But this has to stop.
